item.title: Contratto di ricerca: An Interdisciplinary social science project using audiovisual methods to investigate democratic practices, produce ethnographic knowledge, and communicate research through documentaries, podcasts, and digital storytelling (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-02 Scienza politica

The position involves research, organizational, and project development activities that contribute to the further development of the UNREAL Lab. Additional research activities in the context of other research projects on similar topics may be defined in due course with the mutual agreement between research contract holder and supervisor. If the supervision of this activity taking place within another project is done in detail by a different professor/researcher, the main supervisor has to explicitly countersign the part of the report regarding the activity on additional research projects.
